changes.text: New component: a display/page-title heading with the primary accent underline behind the text, rendered as `h1`–`h6` through the `level` prop so semantics and styling stay independent. Props `accent` (on by default), `centered` and `size`; the `.ss-heading` recipe and its `--ss-heading-size`, `--ss-heading-mb` and `--ss-heading-shadow` tokens ship inside the component, so it works without importing `theme.css`.
